entries.accessDeniedMessage: §cThe Gates of the Nether remain sealed to thee, unless an Undead Soul be offered.
entries.gotItemMessage: §aThe Underworld stirs, and its gates part for thee, heretic! Perdition awaits, mortal. Descend into the flames! The fiery depths of the Nether bid thee welcome.
